units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 9:36">Targ. Jud. IX, 36</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Yoma 74b:3">Yoma 74ᵇ</cite> <he>תוב בט׳</he> sit in the shade.—
<cite ref="Gittin 17a:1">Gitt. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>או בטוּלָּךְ וכ׳</he> either let us live in thy shadow (protection) or in the shadow of the son of Esau (Rome).

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 18b:12">Snh. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>בט׳ תאינה</he> in the shade of a fig-tree; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 2:5:4">Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵇ</cite> top <he>בטֻל תינתא</he>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 1:2:13">Y. Snh. I, 18ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>בטיל הינתא</he> (corr. acc.); a. fr.—Pl. <he>טוּלַּיָּא</he>, <he>טוּלֵּי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 6:4">Targ. Jer. VI, 4</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 9:1">Targ. Is. IX, 1</cite> <he>בארע טולי מותא</he> ed. Lag (oth. ed. <cite ref="I00166"><he>טוּלֵימוֹתָא</he></cite> in one word, h. text <he>צלמית</he>).—
<cite ref="Pesachim 111b:2">Pes. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>חמשה ט׳ וכ׳</he> there are five shades (where demons dwell); a. e.—V. <cite ref="I00511"><he>טְלָלָא</he></cite>.
